Percentage exceeding the median (PEM)

Source: R/sced-nonoverlap.R
scedPEM.Rd

The proportion of intervention-phase observations beyond the baseline median, counting ties as one half (Ma 2006).

Usage

scedPEM(A_data, B_data = NULL, improvement = c("increase", "decrease"))

Arguments

A_data, B_data

Numeric baseline (A) and intervention (B) observations, or pass a data.frame to the phase orchestrator scedABAB().

improvement

"increase" (default) if higher scores are better, or "decrease" if lower scores are the therapeutic goal.

Value

An AnalysisResult (type = "sced_pem") whose estimate is the PEM.

References

Ma H-H (2006). An alternative method for quantitative synthesis of single-subject research: percentage of data points exceeding the median. Behavior Modification, 30(5), 598-617.

See also

scedPND(), scedNAP()

Examples

scedPEM(c(20, 20, 26, 25), c(28, 25, 30, 29))
#> <AnalysisResult> sced_pem 
#>   estimate: 1 
#>   method: PEM 
#>   fields: estimate, ci_lower, ci_upper, baseline_median, n_A, n_B, improvement 
#>   provenance: 1 entr(ies)
